title: Tiny, cute aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='10' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffb066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail wings -->
  <polygon points='18,58 8,44 14,44 24,56' fill='#ff6b2b'/>
  <polygon points='18,58 8,44 14,44 24,56' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a5a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='12' fill='#4ad6ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#9ceaff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='22,62 16,46 24,46 30,62' fill='#ff6b2b'/>
  <polygon points='22,62 16,46 24,46 30,62' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a5a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#2ec4e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='7' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#80e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cockpit / face -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#1a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#1a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='66.6' cy='55.4' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='71.6' cy='55.4' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M66 59 Q68.5 61.5 71 59' stroke='#1a3a4a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd23d'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='84' y='61' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffb800'/>
  <!-- wing stripes -->
  <line x1='30' y1='53' x2='30' y2='57' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='52' x2='42' y2='58' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='52' x2='58' y2='58' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='53' x2='70' y2='57' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- little wheels -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='73' r='3' fill='#ffb800'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='73' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='73' r='3' fill='#ffb800'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='73' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='70' x2='40' y2='73' stroke='#ffd23d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='70' x2='60' y2='73' stroke='#ffd23d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
